Ex: Most of us get over the pratfalls of childhood.

plummet

(verb). tụt, lao thẳng xuống

Ex: Her spirits plummeted at the thought of meeting him again.

plenty

(pronoun). Vô vàn

Ex: ‘Do we need more milk?’ ‘No, there's plenty in the fridge.’

pessimistically

(adverb). bi quan

Ex: These people pessimistically forecast catastrophe in every situation.

pattern

(noun). Khuôn mẫu

Ex: Wages in both sectors have followed a similar pattern.

paradox

(noun). nghịch lý

Ex: It is a curious paradox that professional comedians often have unhappy personal lives.

odds

(noun). khả năng

Ex: The odds are that she'll win.

mindset

(noun). tư duy

Ex: It's extraordinary how hard it is to change the mindset of the public and the press.

mechanism

(noun). Cơ chế hoạt động

Ex: These automatic cameras have a special focusing mechanism.

maintain

(verb). duy trì

Ex: The two countries have always maintained close relations.

litter

(verb). đầy rẫy

Ex: Your essay is littered with spelling mistakes.

insulate

(verb). bảo vệ

Ex: Until now the industry has been insulated from economic realities.

inoculate

(verb). tiêm chủng

Ex: My children have been inoculated against polio.

identify

(verb). Xác định, nhận dạng

Ex: They are trying to identify what is wrong with the present system.

handle

(verb). giải quyết

Ex: A new man was appointed to handle the crisis.

evolutionary

(adjective). tiến triển

Ex: The findings are a significant addition to evolutionary theory.

equanimity

(noun). sự bình thản, trầm tĩn

Ex: She accepted the prospect of her operation with equanimity.

encounter

(verb). chạm trán, gặp gỡ

Ex: We encountered a number of difficulties in the first week.

doggedly

(adverb). gan lì, bền bỉ

Ex: I kept at it, doggedly and patiently, until finally I could skate.

distress

(noun). đau đớn

Ex: The newspaper article caused the actor considerable distress.

derail

(verb). cản trở

Ex: This latest incident could derail the peace process.

depressive

(adjective). trầm cảm, suy nhược

Ex: a depressive disorder/illness Ex: In any given year, 9.5 percent of the population suffer from a depressive illness.

convince

(verb). thuyết phục

Ex: I'd be very surprised if this argument convinces anybody.

commit suicide

(phrase). tự sát

Ex: His father committed suicide.

central

(adjective). quan trọng nhất

Ex: Prevention also plays a central role in traditional medicine.

castigation

(noun). chỉ trích

Ex: Bradley's public castigation of the police chief.

bully

(noun). bắt nạt, kẻ bắt nạt

Ex: Leave him alone, you big bully!

boldly

(adverb). mạnh mẽ, dũng cảm

Ex: He stepped boldly forward to speak.

blistering

(adjective). nghiêm khắc, sắc bén

Ex: The runners set off at a blistering pace.

bankruptcy

(noun). vỡ nợ, phá sản

Ex: Small travel operators are facing bankruptcy due to Covid-19.

ascertain

(verb). Làm chắc chắn

Ex: It can be difficult to ascertain the facts.

altruistic

(adjective). quan tâm, vị tha

Ex: I doubt whether her motives for donating the money are altruistic - she's probably looking for publicity.

aggro

(noun). hành vi hung hãn

Ex: Don't give me any aggro or I'll call the police.

achieve

(verb). Đạt được, giành được

Ex: He had finally achieved success.

optimism

(noun). Tính lạc quan

Ex: We may now look forward with optimism.

discover

(verb). Khám phá

Ex: She recently discovered two fungi that were new to science.

average

(noun). trung bình

Ex: Children here score well above the city average on math and reading tests.

significantly

(adverb). 1 cách đáng kể

Ex: Profits have increased significantly over the past few years.

function

(noun). Chức năng

Ex: The club serves a useful function as a meeting place.

basis

(noun). Nền tảng

Ex: The basis of a good marriage is trust.

optimist

(noun). người lạc quan

Ex: I'm an eternal optimist—I'm sure things will get better.

immune system

(phrase). Hệ thống miễn dịch

Ex: Your immune system consists of all the organs and processes in your body which protect you from illness and infection.

boost

(verb). thúc đẩy

Ex: The movie helped boost her screen career.

attitude

(noun). Thái độ

Ex: If you want to pass your exams you'd better change your attitude!

outlook

(noun). cách nhìn, quan điểm

Ex: Most Western societies are liberal in outlook.

risk

(noun). rủi ro

Ex: The health risks are very low.

mortality

(noun). Tử vong

Ex: After her mother's death, she became acutely aware of her own mortality.

evidence

(noun). Bằng chứng

Ex: Researchers have found clear scientific evidence of a link between exposure to sun and skin cancer.

claim

(noun). lời tuyên bố

Ex: The company had made false claims about its products.

cite

(verb). biểu dương, trích dẫn

Ex: He cited personal reasons for his decision to resign.

setback

(noun). trở ngại, khó khăn

Ex: The team suffered a major setback when their best player was injured.

millennia

(noun). thiên niên kỉ

Ex: For millennia, it was accepted that the earth was at the centre of the universe.

emeritus

(adjective). danh dự

Ex: the Emeritus Professor of Biology Ex: Now an emeritus professor of Manchester University, he has lectured all over the world.

carry

(verb). mang, đem

Ex: Her abilities carried her to the top of her profession.

wealthy

(adjective). giàu

Ex: The deal is about to make him a very wealthy man.

necessarily

(adverb). nhất thiết

Ex: Servants necessarily had close contact with their employers.

material

(adjective). thuộc về vật chất

Ex: The early pioneers had few material resources at their disposal.

forecaster

(noun). người dự đoán

Ex: Some forecasters use informal judgment along with models and data to produce forecasts.

at your/somebody’s disposal

(phrase). có sẵn cho dùng tùy ý

Ex: He will have a car at his disposal for the whole month.

versus

(verb). với, đấu với

Ex: It was the promise of better job opportunities versus the inconvenience of moving away and leaving her friends.

slightly

(adverb). nhỏ, không đáng kể

Ex: She earns slightly less than $100 000 a year.

conduct

(verb). tiến hành

Ex: Police conducted a thorough search of the building.

apt

(adjective). có khuynh hướng

Ex: Babies are apt to put objects into their mouths.

warrant

(verb). bảo đảm

Ex: Further investigation is clearly warranted.

flexible

(adjective). linh hoạt

Ex: Our plans need to be flexible enough to cater for the needs of everyone.

evenness

(noun). tính đều đặn, tính bình thản

Ex: What she liked in him was his evenness of temper.

annual

(adjective). hàng năm

Ex: The 12th annual Music Festival runs from Friday 25th to Monday 28th October.

resilient

(adjective). Kiên cường, có sức chống chịu cao

Ex: He'll get over it—young people are amazingly resilient.

sociologist

(noun). nhà xã hội học

Ex: Like the work of the sociologist, the task of the police investigator is to discover and reconstruct a network of motives.

resilience

(noun). tính kiên cường, khả năng mau phục hồi

Ex: She has shown great resilience to stress.

adversity

(noun). nghịch cảnh

Ex: He overcame many personal adversities.

acquire

(verb). nhận được, đạt được

Ex: She has acquired a good knowledge of English.

robust

(adjective). Mạnh mẽ

Ex: She was almost 90, but still very robust.

cheerful

(adjective). vui mừng, phấn khởi

Ex: He felt bright and cheerful and full of energy.

relationship

(noun). mối quan hệ

Ex: This is an opportunity to build positive customer relationships.

pessimist

(noun). người bi quan

Ex: You don't have to be a pessimist to realize that we're in trouble.

proactive

(adjective). Chủ động

Ex: Managers must be proactive in identifying and preventing potential problems.

handicapped

(adjective). tật nguyền

Ex: The accident left him physically handicapped.

thickskinned

(adjective). trơ, lì

Ex: You have to be pretty thick-skinned to do this job.

open

(adjective). cởi mở

Ex: They are very open to new ideas.

sections.title: Passage 3: The Columbian Exchange
sections.html:
accustomed

(adjective). quen với

Ex: My eyes slowly grew accustomed to the dark.

amateur

(adjective). nghiệp dư

Ex: He believes the archaeological trust has a major educational role to play - for professional and amateur archaeologists alike.

artificial

(adjective). Nhân tạo

Ex: artifical flowers Ex: Her skin glowed in the artificial light.

associate

(verb). liên tưởng, liên kết

Ex: Most people immediately associate addictions with drugs, alcohol and cigarettes.

commingle

(verb). trộn lẫn, hòa lẫn

Ex: The fluid must be prevented from commingling with other fluids.

contaminate

(verb). làm ô nhiễm

Ex: These substances can contaminate groundwater.

contrast

(noun). Sự tương phản

Ex: The flowers provide a contrast with the dark background.

crucial

(adjective). Tối quan trọng

Ex: Parents play a crucial role in preparing their child for school.

defeat

(noun). sự thất bại, sự thua trận

Ex: The world champion has only had two defeats in 20 fights.

dense

(adjective). Dày đặc

Ex: The forest is quite dense at that point.

detonate

(verb). nổ

Ex: The bomb was detonated by remote control.

divergent

(adjective). chia ra

Ex: The two scientists have followed divergent paths since the 1990s.

equivalent

(noun). vật tương đương

Ex: Send €20 or the equivalent in your own currency.

establishment

(noun). thiết lập

Ex: The speaker announced the establishment of a new college.

evidence

(noun). Bằng chứng

Ex: Researchers have found clear scientific evidence of a link between exposure to sun and skin cancer.

evolution

(noun). sự tiến hoá

Ex: Evolution requires intermediate forms between species.

expropriation

(noun). sự tước, sự chiếm đoạt

Ex: Villagers are protesting the expropriation of their lands to build a new international airport.

fare well

(phrase). thành công

Ex: He fared well against his main rival.

foster

(verb). bồi dưỡng

Ex: The club's aim is to foster better relations within the community.

inferiority

(noun). sự kém hơn

Ex: She accepted her inferiority to her rivals.

initially

(adverb). lúc đầu

Ex: Initially, the system worked well.

insufficient

(adjective). không đủ

Ex: The management paid insufficient attention to working conditions.

intentionally

(adverb). cố ý

Ex: She would never intentionally hurt anyone.

Millennium

(noun). thiên niên kỷ

Ex: Imagine what the world will be like at the end of the next millennium.

pathogen

(noun). mầm bệnh

Ex: the spread of pathogens by insects Ex: A part of the stool sample was processed for the detection of bacterial pathogens.

plunge

(verb). lao xuống

Ex: This year profits plunged by 40 per cent.

prove

(verb). Chứng minh

Ex: She was determined to prove everyone wrong.

separation

(noun). sự tách ra

Ex: They were reunited after a separation of more than 20 years.

superiority

(noun). sự trội hơn

Ex: We should make use of our superiority in numbers.

tendency

(noun). Khuynh hướng

Ex: Our best intentions are sometimes subverted by our natural tendency to selfishness.

tolerate

(verb). Khoan dung

Ex: This sort of behaviour will not be tolerated.

usurp

(verb). chiếm, chiếm đoạt

Ex: He attempted to usurp the principal's authority.

voyager

(noun). du khách

Ex: The early voyagers thought they had landed on the Indian coast.

wander

(verb). Lang thang

Ex: We spent the morning wandering around the old part of the city.

colonist

(noun). thực dân

Ex: Attempts by Spanish and French colonists to establish settlements were unsuccessful.

cultivate

(verb). cày cấy

Ex: The land around here has never been cultivated.

import

(verb). Nhập khẩu

Ex: The country has to import most of its raw materials.

description

(noun). Sự miêu tả, sự mô tả

Ex: The name means ‘no trees’ and it is an accurate description of the island.

species

(noun). giống loài

Ex: Most of the known rhino species are West African.

explosion

(noun). sự bùng nổ

Ex: How can we keep up with the information explosion?

factor

(noun). Nhân tố

Ex: The result will depend on a number of different factors.

indispensable

(adjective). rất quan trọng

Ex: Cars have become an indispensable part of our lives.

explain

(verb). giải thích

Ex: He was trying to explain the difference between hip hop and rap.

demographic

(adjective). thuộc nhân khẩu học

Ex: There have been monumental social and demographic changes in the country.

influence

(noun). ảnh hưởng

Ex: His early work shows the influence of Cézanne and Matisse.

continent

(noun). Châu lục

Ex: He crossed a whole continent to find his family.

formation

(noun). Sự hình thành; Đội hình

Ex: This dispute led to the formation of a new breakaway group.

split

(verb). Phân tách; Chia ra

Ex: She split the class into groups of four.

decline

(verb). sụt giảm

Ex: Support for the party continues to decline.

infectious

(adjective). truyền nhiễm

Ex: Flu is highly infectious.

indigenous

(adjective). bản địa

Ex: The kangaroo is indigenous to Australia.

suffer

(verb). chịu đựng

Ex: The company suffered huge losses in the last financial year.

spectacular

(adjective). Ngoạn mục

Ex: It was a spectacular achievement on their part.

crop

(noun). cây trồng

Ex: The crops are regularly sprayed with pesticides.

origin

(noun). Nguồn gốc

Ex: This particular custom has its origins in Wales.

overall

(adjective). toàn thể, chung

Ex: The overall quality of the articles is good.

affect

(verb). ảnh hưởng

Ex: Your opinion will not affect my decision.

revolutionise

(verb). cách mạng hóa

Ex: Newton's discoveries revolutionized physics.

ineffective

(adjective). không hiệu quả

Ex: The new drug was ineffective.

explanation

(noun). giải thích

Ex: The most likely explanation is that his plane was delayed.

adapt

(verb). điều chỉnh

Ex: These styles can be adapted to suit individual tastes.

invasion

(noun). sự xâm nhập

Ex: Farmers are struggling to cope with an invasion of slugs.

account

(noun). Lời tường thuật

Ex: The diaries contained a detailed account of the writer's experiences in China.

ashore

(adverb). lên bờ, vào bờ

Ex: Strong winds blew the ship ashore.

hospitable

(adjective). dễ chịu

Ex: The local people are very hospitable to strangers.

terrain

(noun). địa hình

Ex: They walked for miles across steep and inhospitable terrain.

cattle

(noun). gia súc

Ex: He moved his cattle farther down into the valley in winter.

fence

(noun). hàng rào

Ex: The house was surrounded by a tall, wooden fence.

livestock

(noun). Gia súc, gia cầm

Ex: The organic livestock industry has grown substantially in the last few years.

settler

(noun). người đến định cư

Ex: Most of the settlers came from England.

brutality

(noun). sự hung ác, sự tàn bạo

Ex: The shock of inhuman brutality was sufficient to traumatize the inhabitants into submission.

brutally

(adverb). hung bạo, tàn nhẫn

Ex: He was brutally assaulted.

resistance

(noun). sự chống cự, sự kháng lại

Ex: Resistance to change has nearly destroyed the industry.

displace

(verb). chiếm chỗ

Ex: Gradually factory workers have been displaced by machines.

domesticated

(adjective). thuần hóa

Ex: These animals are only partly domesticated.

raise

(verb). nuôi dưỡng

Ex: They were both raised in the South.

contribution

(noun). sự đóng góp

Ex: a significant contribution to scientific knowledge Ex: He made a very positive contribution to the success of the project.

essential

(noun). điều cần thiết

Ex: The local government is not able to provide essential services such as gas, water and electricity.

major

(adjective). chủ yếu, quan trọng

Ex: He played a major role in setting up the system.

various

(adjective). khác nhau, đa dạng

Ex: We talked about jobs, family, football and various other things.

appalling

(adjective). gây kinh hoàng

Ex: The prisoners were living in appalling conditions.

interior

(noun). nội địa

Ex: Wooden shoes are an item of traditional dress among rural dwellers in the interior of the region.

missionary

(noun). người truyền giáo

Ex: He spent 15 years as a missionary in Africa.

venture

(verb). mạo hiểm, đánh bạo

Ex: It was wrong to venture his financial security on such a risky deal.

decline

(noun). sụt giảm

Ex: a decline in population following outbreaks of plague Ex: Orders for new ships are rising, after several years of steady decline.

entire

(adjective). toàn bộ

Ex: You two are her favourite people in the entire world.

exist

(verb). Tồn tại

Ex: I don't think ghosts exist.

feature

(noun). đặc tính

Ex: Teamwork is a key feature of the training programme.

invader

(noun). kẻ xâm nhập

Ex: a foreign invader Ex: They prepared to repel the invaders.

reverse

(verb). đảo ngược lại

Ex: The government has failed to reverse the economic decline.

triumph

(noun). chiến thắng

Ex: It was a personal triumph over her old rival.
